title: Pass or Fail (partitioningBy)
hints: Arrays.stream(line.split(" ")).map(...) turns each name:score entry into a Student record.
Collectors.partitioningBy(s -> s.score() >= 60) gives a Map<Boolean, List<Student>>: get(true) are the passed, get(false) the failed.
Join names with .map(Student::name).collect(Collectors.joining(", ")); averageAsDouble comes from mapToInt(...).average().

pt-br.title: Aprovado ou reprovado (partitioningBy)
hints: Arrays.stream(line.split(" ")).map(...) transforma cada entrada nome:nota em um record Student.
Collectors.partitioningBy(s -> s.score() >= 60) dá um Map<Boolean, List<Student>>: get(true) são os aprovados, get(false) os reprovados.
Junte os nomes com .map(Student::name).collect(Collectors.joining(", ")); a média vem de mapToInt(...).average().
